Criteria:
- E1: Completeness: is every requirement, constraint and deliverable that the document states listed? For each missing one, quote its exact sentence from the document as evidence.
- E2: Faithfulness: is every listed item actually required by the document (not invented, not background, not a reading instruction)?
- E3: Kind: requirement = what the solution or the work must do or be; constraint = a limit on how or with what (language, library, team size, deadline, page limit); deliverable = what to hand in. Is each item the right kind?
- E4: Priority: must (must, shall, required, a plain instruction), should (should, recommended), could (may, optional, extra credit). Is each requirement's priority right?

Conventions (the same as the extractor's): one item per sentence or list item; setup steps that are not marked or checked (install a tool, clone a repository, create an environment), background, motivation and reading instructions are NOT items; a sentence ending with ':' that introduces a list is not an item, the list items under it are. Marking tables and their criteria (E ids) are checked by code: do not report them.

=== Document: marking_scheme.pdf
## Software Design Project: Marking Scheme
This document explains how the final project is marked. The project is worth 50 marks in total.
| Section | Criterion | Marks | Excellent | Adequate | Weak |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Analysis | Use-case diagram covers all actors | 6 | All actors and use cases, correct notation (6) | Most actors, minor notation errors (4) | Missing actors or wrong notation (1) |
|  | Requirements are testable | 8 | Every requirement has a measurable acceptance test (8) | Most requirements are testable (5) | Few requirements are testable (2) |
| Design | Class diagram matches the code | 10 | Diagram and code agree completely (10) | Small differences (6) | Diagram does not match the code (2) |
|  | Design patterns are justified | 6 | Each pattern is explained with a reason (6) | Patterns named but not justified (3) | No patterns or wrong use (0) |
| Implementation | Working implementation | 12 | All features work in the demo (12) | Main features work (7) | Demo fails (2) |
|  | Automated tests | 8 | Tests cover all main features and pass (8) | Some tests (4) | No tests (0) |
Total: 50 marks
## Rules
- The design document must be submitted as a single PDF file.
- The demo video must not be longer than five minutes.
- Every team member must present part of the demo.

C3 [constraint, process] Every team member must present part of the demo. | quote: "Every team member must present part of the demo."
